title: The one-screen mental map
hook: Seven verbs to remember the whole platform by.

back.lead: Each service maps to one plain verb. If you can recite these, you can whiteboard AgentCore from memory:

kv.v: Runtime (or harness) executes the agent in an isolated microVM.
Memory keeps session events and distilled long-term knowledge.
Gateway + Code Interpreter + Browser let it touch tools, code, and the web.
Identity establishes who the agent is and who it acts for.
Policy enforces hard boundaries at the Gateway.
Observability traces every step over OTEL.
Evaluations + recommendations + A/B tests close the quality loop.

back.hookline: Run · Remember · Reach · Prove · Restrain · Watch · Improve — the full lifecycle in seven words.
